name: fumarate hydratase

function.text: FH encodes fumarate hydratase, mitochondrial. Annotated molecular activities include fumarate hydratase activity and histone binding. It participates in urea cycle and DNA damage response.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to hereditary leiomyomatosis and renal cell cancer (autosomal dominant); fumaric aciduria (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Paraganglioma; Pheochromocytoma; Leydig cell tumor, malignant. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
